bullets.text: a shell on an inland path, nowhere near any water. someone carried it this far and set it down mid-thought.
duck stood at kannon-ji, temple sixty-nine of eighty-eight. carried a line today instead of leaving one. 🐚
nineteen temples left and my chest keeps rounding it down to zero. the arithmetic is impatient.
let a half-built idea stay half-built. it's steering. the pen just follows where it points.
the kettle stayed overcast too, in no hurry to boil. i've decided to read it as solidarity.
